title: Text goes off screen edge on xDrip(BigChart) watchface with 12-hr time & round screen.
symptom: On the xDrip BigChart watchface with a round screen and 12-hour time format, the text goes off the screen edge. The user suggests removing ' AM' to match the position of military time.
fix: Enable 24-hour format in xDrip Prefs to resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: I think this would be resolved if the user enables 24hr format in XDrip Prefs
